project: Q0-IV infinite volume and critical height
load_bearing_target: Fixed-b thermodynamic stabilization of the pairing-defect rate and selected-set Campbell control under the configured pair-Palm law.
terminal_states: BLOCKED-EXTERNAL with a named unavailable capability

central_hypotheses.statement: At every fixed b>0, the pair-Palm influence region has a uniformly finite area/radius moment as r tends to zero and L tends to infinity.
central_hypotheses.kill_condition: Boundary-touch probability or influence-area tails fail to stabilize with L at a fixed positive b.

central_hypotheses.statement: The expected number of window saddles in the random influence region is bounded by a finite selection-amplification factor times its expected area and the stationary marked intensity.
central_hypotheses.kill_condition: The cross-fitted selection coefficient grows without bound as the height window shrinks or L increases.

central_hypotheses.statement: Fixed positive b is subcritical and stabilizing; susceptibility diverges only as b approaches zero.
central_hypotheses.kill_condition: A fixed b>0 exhibits nonvanishing wrap probability or unbounded stabilized influence size as L increases.

artifact_control: de-truncation controlled by requiring negligible wrap probability
same Fourier conventions at every L
merge-tree construction rather than raw cluster area alone
fixed seeds and sample counts before execution

competing_predictions.prediction: (1-q_L)/r^3 converges to an L-independent finite limit at every fixed b>0
stabilization degrades with decreasing b and fails only at the b=0 critical level

existing_priors_not_theorem_inputs: The value-pin BF probe showed wrap probability tending to zero through b=0.2 by L=96 and indicated a large but finite susceptibility near b=0.2.
The selected-set Campbell instrument reported order-one selection amplification around 4.5-5.5 over its resolved thin-window range, not evidence of divergence.

objectives.name: Influence-region definition
objectives.pass: Define the minimal merge-tree data region determining the death partner and prove measurability/localization interfaces.

objectives.name: Selected-set Campbell identity
objectives.pass: Write the exact same-field versus independent-field cross-fit identity and isolate lambda as a weighted Palm likelihood ratio.

objectives.name: Thermodynamic experiment
objectives.pass: Execute all frozen L,b,r cells with wrap-controlled sample sizes and report finite-size scaling without post hoc cell deletion.

objectives.name: Fixed-b theorem or kill
objectives.pass: Either prove finite fixed-b susceptibility and selected-set Campbell control, or issue a registered kill with the first fixed positive height at which uniformity fails.

objectives.name: Critical-height law
objectives.pass: Estimate or bound the divergence of susceptibility and selection amplification as b approaches zero.
